_comment: L110 T0.1 — channel content strategy. Organic = HARD geopolitics lock. Clip = dynamic performance-weighted (handled by lib/clip-creator-ranker.js, not a fixed list).

organic.note: A trending topic must hit >=1 matchKeyword (and 0 strong rejectKeywords) to be scripted. Keeps RagnarShortsUltimate classifiable as a geopolitics channel.

clip.note: NOT a fixed creator lock (user decision). lib/clip-creator-ranker.js scores the full creator pool by (our per-creator AVD% x views from live analytics) x (current trending velocity), and picks the day's clips from the top. Self-converges on what gains views.
clip.brainrotNote: Editorial prior on how FUNNY/chaotic/brain-rot a creator is (user: clips were 'not funny not brainrot' — dry gossip/politics podcasts kept winning the flat cold-start ranker). High = comedy/chaos/viral moments; low = talking-head interview/politics. Dominates at cold-start, fades as live analytics (performanceWeight) accumulate.
